name: Assimilations
description: Not every gift of the Maw is brewed in the Matrix. Some traits it drinks in from the world itself, once the hunter has proven a deed. Assimilations belong to the hunter, not to the vessel: a replacement Maw benefits at once, and nothing is lost on death. Their power slumbers unless a Maw is carried, and hovering over the beast shows how many have been taken in.
